key.name: toggle-dock
key.description: Toggles dock visibility and remembers the choice for the active app/window during this session.

key.name: toggle-workspace-dock
key.description: Toggles the dock visibility baseline for the active workspace during this session.

key.name: remember-session-state
key.summary: Remember dock state for current session
key.description: When true, toggling the dock via shortcut while an app is focused remembers that state for the current session.

key.name: remember-per-window
key.description: When true, manual session dock overrides apply to the active window instead of all windows of the application.

key.name: per-window-apps
key.description: List of application desktop IDs that isolate shortcut dock toggles per window.

key.name: per-app-apps
key.description: List of application desktop IDs that apply shortcut dock toggles to all windows of the application.

key.name: request-add-workspace
key.summary: Signal to create a new workspace in GNOME Shell
key.description: Incremented by preferences to request GNOME Shell to append a new workspace.

key.name: workspace-list
key.description: List of active and dynamically available workspaces synced from GNOME Shell.

key.name: edge-hover-reveal
key.summary: Reveal dock on mouse hover at screen edge
key.description: When true, hovering or pushing the mouse at the screen edge reveals the dock.

key.name: notify-on-app-toggle
key.summary: Show notification on app dock toggle
key.description: Show on-screen display notification when toggling active app dock visibility.

key.name: notify-on-workspace-toggle
key.summary: Show notification on workspace dock toggle
key.description: Show on-screen display notification when toggling workspace dock baseline.

key.name: notification-vertical-offset
key.description: Vertical distance in pixels to elevate the notification above bottom docks.
